quality_rule: Absolute deviation of median pairwise disabled/control ratio from 1 <= 5%; median absolute deviation of pairwise ratios <= 5 percentage points; absolute deviation of pooled enabled/disabled P50 from 1 <= 5%; CPU/wall <= 5%, TSC calibration <= 1%; at least 100 sampled calls per function. All 6 pairs are included; no outliers removed. These are preregistered robust pair statistics, not the failed two-process protocol.
scope: Targeted R0 call attribution; not formal benchmark. QueryGuard checkSlow is only externally linked calls; same-object calls can bypass wrapper. Nested functions cannot be added.
